basic_details.job_title: AWTM Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 40 Mechanical Fitter, Electrical Fitter and More Posts
basic_details.job_location: North Twenty Four Parganas, West Bengal

qualification.details: Educational Qualification: Matriculation plus National Trade Certificate (NTC) or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) issued by the National Council of Training in Vocational Trades (NCTVT) in the respective trade as per SRO: | Electrical Fitter: Electrical Fitter trade Mechanical Fitter: General Fitter (Mechanical) trade Machinist: Machinist trade Turner: Turner trade Electroplater: Electroplater trade Heat Treatment Operator: Forger and Heat Treater trade | Age Limit: 18 to 35 years as on the last date of receipt of application. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government rules: 5 years for SC/ST (for posts reserved for SC/ST), 3 years for OBC Non-Creamy Layer (for posts reserved for OBC), military service duration plus 3 years for Ex-Servicemen, 10 years for PwD (PH), 13 years for SC/ST PwD, and 15 years for OBC PwD. Matriculation/Class 10 Board certificate or marksheet serves as proof of date of birth.

selection_process: Candidates will be selected based on marks obtained in the NCTVT (NCVT) Trade Test / Practical Test alone. The cut-off percentage to be called for the trade test will be determined by Academy of Weapon Technology & Management

Ichapur based on total marks obtained in NCTVT. The trade test will be conducted by AWTM Ichapur. The merit list will be prepared based on combined marks obtained in the NCTVT examination and the trade/practical test

carrying a weightage of 80% and 20% respectively. Shortlisted candidates in order of merit will be called for document verification up to the limit of notified vacancies per discipline and category. A ratio of 1:10 will be maintained for vacancies and interviews if applicable.

content_sections.heading: AWTM Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: ↗ Official Notification & Application Form Candidates must download and print the application form, fill it in Block Letters, and send it by post with the required self-attested documents and photographs to the prescribed address. The application must reach the authorities on or before 2 November 2026. A Rs. 100 demand draft is required, except for exempted categories.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent by post to the following address: THE CHIEF GENERAL MANAGER, ACADEMY OF WEAPON TECHNOLOGY & MANAGEMENT, ICHAPUR, P.O.- Ichapur, Nawabganj, Dist. – 24 Parganas(N), PIN – 743144 Candidates must print the application form from the website, fill it exclusively in Block Letters, and mail it along with required self-attested documents and two additional self-attested photographs (with signatures on the back). The envelope must clearly display the following text: “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ‘Trades Name’ ON CONTRACT BASIS” FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Matriculation plus National Trade Certificate (NTC) or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) issued by the National Council of Training in Vocational Trades (NCTVT) in the respective trade as per SRO: Electrical Fitter: Electrical Fitter trade Mechanical Fitter: General Fitter (Mechanical) trade Machinist: Machinist trade Turner: Turner trade Electroplater: Electroplater trade Heat Treatment Operator: Forger and Heat Treater trade Age Limit: 18 to 35 years as on the last date of receipt of application. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government rules: 5 years for SC/ST (for posts reserved for SC/ST), 3 years for OBC Non-Creamy Layer (for posts reserved for OBC), military service duration plus 3 years for Ex-Servicemen, 10 years for PwD (PH), 13 years for SC/ST PwD, and 15 years for OBC PwD. Matriculation/Class 10 Board certificate or marksheet serves as proof of date of birth.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational and qualification certificates (Matriculation and NTC/NAC) Proof of date of birth (Class 10 certificate/marksheet) Caste or category certificate in the prescribed format (including Appendix-1 Undertaking for OBC candidates) Two additional self-attested photographs with signatures on the reverse Demand Draft of Rs. 100/- drawn in favor of "Ordnance Factories Institute of Learning, Ishapore Payable at State Bank of India, Ishapore, Branch Code 01797 (IFSC - SBIN 0001797)" (exempted for SC/ST, Ex-Servicemen, and PwD candidates)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected based on marks obtained in the NCTVT (NCVT) Trade Test / Practical Test alone. The cut-off percentage to be called for the trade test will be determined by Academy of Weapon Technology & Management, Ichapur based on total marks obtained in NCTVT. The trade test will be conducted by AWTM Ichapur. The merit list will be prepared based on combined marks obtained in the NCTVT examination and the trade/practical test, carrying a weightage of 80% and 20% respectively. Shortlisted candidates in order of merit will be called for document verification up to the limit of notified vacancies per discipline and category. A ratio of 1:10 will be maintained for vacancies and interviews if applicable.

faq.question: Q1. What is AWTM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AWTM Recruitment 2026 is an offline recruitment drive announced by the Academy of Weapon Technology and Management, Ichapur, to fill 40 contract vacancies across various trades like Fitter, Machinist, Turner, Electroplater, and Heat Treatment Operator.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 40 vacancies are available across 6 designated trades under advertisement number 01/Hiring-GSF/AWTM/2026-27.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AWTM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of offline applications at AWTM Ichapur is 2 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation (Class 10) along with an NTC or NAC certificate issued by NCTVT in the relevant trade specific to the post applied for.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age of general candidates must be between 18 and 35 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications, with permissible relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee, and who is exempted?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee is Rs. 100/- payable via Demand Draft. SC/ST, Ex-Servicemen, and physically disabled (PwD) candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for AWTM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application form, fill it out entirely in Block Letters, attach the required self-attested documents, fee draft, and photographs, and mail it via post to the Chief General Manager at AWTM Ichapur.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: Selection is based entirely on marks secured in the NCTVT exam (80% weightage) and the Trade/Practical Test (20% weightage) conducted by AWTM Ichapur, followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Are these permanent positions or on contract?
faq.answer: These appointments are made on a full-time contract basis for an initial duration of 1 year, extendable by up to another 2 years based on performance evaluations and company requirements.

faq.question: Q10. What pay scale is offered to selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected contract personnel receive a consolidated monthly salary comprising basic pay corresponding to the current CPC Level-1 plus Dearness Allowance as per government rules.
